title: Toolchain currency: ruflo
command: test -n "$(bun info 'ruflo' version 2>/dev/null)" && test "$(bun info 'ruflo' version 2>/dev/null)" = "$(bun pm ls -g 2>/dev/null | grep -oE 'ruflo@[0-9][^ ]*' | head -1 | sed 's/.*@//')"
note: The installed global version is behind the registry latest by three patch releases. Bun global installs resolve under BUN_INSTALL_CACHE_DIR (/run/user/1001/yazelix/volatile/cache/bun), a runtime tmpfs location, and may disappear after reboot.
